personal.preferred_title: Senior Python Platform / Data Reliability Engineer | Production Systems, SQL, Airflow & Observability

summary: Senior Python, data reliability, and production engineering professional with 20+ years of enterprise experience across Python 3, SQL, Linux/Unix, ETL/data workflows, REST API concepts, Airflow, Docker, CI/CD concepts, monitoring/observability, production troubleshooting, and resilient long-running pipeline design. Strong background modernizing fragile manual processes into repeatable automated workflows, validating production outputs, supporting critical enterprise operations, and building documented systems that are easier to monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain. Best aligned to Python platform/data reliability roles requiring scalable Python workflows, SQL databases, Linux, Airflow, Docker, Git, production monitoring, fault-tolerant processing patterns, and enterprise troubleshooting; Azure, AKS/Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, Redis, Solr, and deep cloud-native backend ownership are positioned carefully as adjacent or learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

Implemented production checks for row counts, missing or late feeds, nulls, duplicate keys, unmatched joins, freshness, abnormal metric movement, and output consistency against prior trusted runs.

Created runbooks, support procedures, metric definitions, validation logic, data flow notes, and troubleshooting documentation to improve maintainability and team handoff.

Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, engineering, and business teams to prioritize incidents, explain findings, coordinate fixes, and improve reliability of production reporting workflows.
